request_text: Before I decide what to do with this account, please send me a copy of the personal data you hold about me in a downloadable format. Do not close or delete anything yet.
Por favor, dejen de enviarme correos promocionales y bórrenme de las listas de marketing. Quiero conservar mi cuenta y mi historial de pedidos.
I used this Yahoo address before changing the email on my account. Please remove records linked to both the old and current addresses.
Encerrei a minha conta, mas um link antigo de “baixar os seus dados” ainda funciona. Por favor, apaguem também esse arquivo de exportação.
Earlier this month I only asked you to update my phone number, but I have now decided to leave. Please delete my account and the personal data connected to it.
Jag vill att mitt konto och de personuppgifter som är kopplade till det raderas permanent. Säkerhetsloggar får sparas om det krävs.
